author: Inside Edition
description: When a deer got tangled in a hammock, first responders came to its aid. Not only did police officers show up, but so did officials from the Ohio Department of Natural Resources -- all to make sure this buck would be set free. It didn't take long to cut the netting from his antlers, but then they had to prepare for his release. Once the deer realized he wasn't tied up anymore, he quickly scampered away. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Rescuers Cut Deer Loose From Hammock
